# Underset

> Free desktop app for Windows and macOS that finds the tracks your favourite DJs play. Type a DJ's name and a period; Underset reads their public tracklists on 1001Tracklists and gives you one clean list of every track they played.

## What it does
- Search by DJ / artist name and pick a period (quick ranges or exact custom dates).
- Merges all of that DJ's sets in the period into one list.
- Leaves out IDs, unreleased tracks and duplicates by default (optional: include them).
- Spotify and SoundCloud shortcuts for tracks that are linked there.
- Saves the list as a .txt file, one "Artist – Title" per line.

## Facts
- Price: free for personal use. No account needed.
- Platforms: Windows 10 (1809+) and Windows 11; macOS 14 Sonoma or newer (Apple Silicon and Intel). No mobile app; a web preview (any device) lists a DJ's sets in a period with identified-track counts, without track names.
- Data source: public pages of 1001Tracklists. Not affiliated with 1001Tracklists, Spotify or SoundCloud.
- License: freeware; the app is not open source.
